messages:
ana: quick ping — internal report: the image in docs/optimize/cache-tuning.md throws a 403 in production. Also noticed frontmatter missing `maintainer`. Can someone grab this tiny fix? /cc @paul @tina
docscare-bot: [alert] asset-check failed: /docs/optimize/cache-tuning#diagram (403) — scanned 2025-08-14T09:12:03Z
paul: I can take it. Do we want to add `maintainer: eng-platform` in the frontmatter or add an OWNERS entry for the page?
tina: Add maintainer in frontmatter (short-term) and add you to OWNERS for the optimize folder (longer-term). That keeps attribution in the file and the owners map in sync.
paul: Plan: 1) replace absolute image URL with relative `/assets/images/cache-tuning-diagram.svg` 2) add `maintainer: paul` to frontmatter 3) update OWNERS.yaml under `optimize/` 4) add changelog line. Will run local smoke.
paul: local commands I'll run: ```bash
git checkout -b docs/optimize-img-fix-295182
# update file, then
mkdocs build && tools/link-checker --site-dir site
# open PR once green
git push origin docs/optimize-img-fix-295182
```
tina: also please add alt text for the diagram (`alt="cache tuning flow"`) and a one-line note in the doc footer: "Asset rehosted to CDN (2025-08-14)" so internal search shows context.
paul: good call. I'll include that. PR incoming in ~20m.
docscare-bot: PR hint: include the keyword `smallfix` in the title to skip full docs review queue.
paul: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9033 — title: "docs: optimize cache-tuning image + maintainer" — labels: smallfix, docs
tina: will review. tiny nit: prefer the relative path without leading slash in markdown so our link checker normalizes correctly.
paul: updated to use `assets/images/cache-tuning-diagram.svg` (no leading slash), added frontmatter `maintainer: paul`, added OWNERS entry, added changelog line: "2025-08-14 — optimize/cache-tuning: image rehost & maintainer — paul"
docscare-bot: Deploy preview ready: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.com/9033 — link-checker passed, image served 200
ana: (typo)
ana: thanks all! I'll merge after tina gives LG. :rocket:
